svg.text: Logic power: USB default + MCU-selectable main battery
Fixed 5 V USB only | no external USB comparator | MCU_SELECT_MAIN: low/Hi-Z = USB priority, high = main priority
PROTOTYPE CONNECTION GUIDE | Same net label = same wire. Read README.md before implementation.
USB present: prefer IN1, even if main has higher voltage.
MCU reset / unpowered: R20 holds CP2 low.
Both OV pins grounded; no separate 4.4 V USB cutoff.
MCU high on CP2 prefers main when main is TPS-valid.
If main is absent, USB remains available as fallback.
Weak USB can cause brownouts; not a clean-off guarantee.
HIGH: prefer main (not a hard USB disable)
Same raw battery net as pyro IN2 and R15.
Do not retain a parallel USB→3V3 power path.
ST high: USB selected OR neither valid.
Shared U3: reuse existing C8 (100 nF) and R17 (100 kΩ SENSE_EN pull-down).
Channel 3 is no longer grounded: pin 10 = USB_DIV, pin 9 = ADC_USB, pin 11 = SENSE_EN.
The companion pyro sheet / manifest are updated to match; only one U3 is populated.
R24/R25: 0.1%; R18–R23: 1%. U5 and C13 removed. R18/R20/R21 changed. See README before updating an earlier schematic.
This powers logic only. Fixed-5-V USB current authorization and input protection remain USB-front-end requirements. See README for limits.
Dot = junction. Jump = no connection. Repeated net names connect across sheets. Common GND. No pyro battery feeds this mux.
